content:
# Crossplane XRD + Composition for Versioned Bucket Infrastructure

Below is a production-ready implementation using Crossplane's function-patch-and-transform mode, supporting both dev and prod environments as per the canonical scenario.

## 1. CompositeResourceDefinition (XRD)

```yaml
---
apiVersion: apiextensions.crossplane.io/v1
kind: CompositeResourceDefinition
metadata:
  name: versionedbuckets.spine.example.com
spec:
  group: spine.example.com
  names:
    kind: VersionedBucket
    plural: versionedbuckets
  claimNames:
    kind: VersionedBucketClaim
    plural: versionedbucketclaims
  versions:
  - name: v1alpha1
    served: true
    referenceable: true
    schema:
      openAPIV3Schema:
        type: object
        properties:
          spec:
            type: object
            required:
            - environment
            - region
            - bucketName
            - iamRoleName
            properties:
              environment:
                description: "Environment: dev or prod"
                type: string
                enum: [dev, prod]
              region:
                description: "Primary AWS region"
                type: string
                enum: [us-east-1, us-west-2]
              bucketName:
                description: "S3 bucket name (must be globally unique)"
                type: string
                minLength: 3
                maxLength: 63
              rdsInstanceClass:
                description: "RDS instance class"
                type: string
                enum: [db.t3.micro, db.t3.small, db.t3.medium]
              rdsAllocatedStorage:
                description: "RDS allocated storage in GB"
                type: integer
                minimum: 20
                maximum: 1000
                default: 20
              iamRoleName:
                description: "IAM role name for service accounts"
                type: string
              enableOIDCTrust:
                description: "Enable OIDC trust policy (recommended for prod)"
                type: boolean
                default: false
          status:
            type: object
            properties:
              bucketArn:
                description: "ARN of the S3 bucket"
                type: string
              bucketRegionalDomainName:
                description: "Regional domain name of bucket"
                type: string
              rdsEndpoint:
                description: "RDS instance endpoint"
                type: string
              rdsPort:
                description: "RDS instance port"
                type: integer
              iamRoleArn:
                description: "ARN of the IAM role"
                type: string
              replicationRoleArn:
                description: "ARN of S3 replication role (prod only)"
                type: string
```

## 2. Composition (function-patch-and-transform)

```yaml
---
apiVersion: apiextensions.crossplane.io/v1
kind: Composition
metadata:
  name: versionedbuckets.spine.example.com
  namespace: crossplane-system
spec:
  compositeTypeRef:
    apiVersion: spine.example.com/v1alpha1
    kind: VersionedBucket
  mode: Resources
  resources:
  
  # ============================================================
  # S3 BUCKET RESOURCES
  # ============================================================
  
  - name: s3-bucket
    base:
      apiVersion: s3.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
      kind: Bucket
      metadata:
        labels:
          component: storage
      spec:
        forProvider:
          acl: private
          region: us-east-1
    patches:
    - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
      fromFieldPath: spec.bucketName
      toFieldPath: metadata.name
    - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
      fromFieldPath: spec.bucketName
      toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.bucket
    - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
      fromFieldPath: spec.region
      toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.region
    - type: ToCompositeFieldPath
      fromFieldPath: status.atProvider.arn
      toFieldPath: status.bucketArn
    - type: ToCompositeFieldPath
      fromFieldPath: status.atProvider.regionName
      toFieldPath: status.bucketRegionalDomainName
      transforms:
      - type: string
        string:
          fmt: "%s.s3.%s.amazonaws.com"
          args:
          - spec.bucketName
  
  - name: s3-versioning
    base:
      apiVersion: s3.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
      kind: BucketVersioning
      spec:
        forProvider:
          versioningConfiguration:
          - status: Enabled
    patches:
    - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
      fromFieldPath: spec.bucketName
      toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.bucket
    dependsOn:
    - name: s3-bucket
  
  - name: s3-server-side-encryption
    base:
      apiVersion: s3.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
      kind: BucketServerSideEncryptionConfiguration
      spec:
        forProvider:
          rule:
          - applyServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
            - sseAlgorithm: AES256
    patches:
    - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
      fromFieldPath: spec.bucketName
      toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.bucket
    dependsOn:
    - name: s3-bucket
  
  - name: s3-public-access-block
    base:
      apiVersion: s3.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
      kind: BucketPublicAccessBlock
      spec:
        forProvider:
          blockPublicAcls: true
          blockPublicPolicy: true
          ignorePublicAcls: true
          restrictPublicBuckets: true
    patches:
    - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
      fromFieldPath: spec.bucketName
      toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.bucket
    dependsOn:
    - name: s3-bucket
  
  # S3 Cross-Region Replication (prod only)
  - name: s3-replication-role
    base:
      apiVersion: iam.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
      kind: Role
      metadata:
        labels:
          component: replication
      spec:
        forProvider:
          assumeRolePolicy: |
            {
              "Version": "2012-10-17",
              "Statement": [
                {
                  "Effect": "Allow",
                  "Principal": {
                    "Service": "s3.amazonaws.com"
                  },
                  "Action": "sts:AssumeRole"
                }
              ]
            }
    patches:
    - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
      fromFieldPath: spec.bucketName
      toFieldPath: metadata.name
      transforms:
      - type: string
        string:
          fmt: "%s-s3-replication"
    - type: ToCompositeFieldPath
      fromFieldPath: status.atProvider.arn
      toFieldPath: status.replicationRoleArn
  
  - name: s3-replication-policy
    base:
      apiVersion: iam.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
      kind: RolePolicy
      spec:
        forProvider:
          policy: |
            {
              "Version": "2012-10-17",
              "Statement": [
                {
                  "Effect": "Allow",
                  "Action": [
                    "s3:GetReplicationConfiguration",
                    "s3:ListBucket"
                  ],
                  "Resource": "*"
                },
                {
                  "Effect": "Allow",
                  "Action": [
                    "s3:GetObjectVersionForReplication",
                    "s3:GetObjectVersionAcl"
                  ],
                  "Resource": "*"
                },
                {
                  "Effect": "Allow",
                  "Action": [
                    "s3:ReplicateObject",
                    "s3:ReplicateDelete"
                  ],
                  "Resource": "*"
                }
              ]
            }
    patches:
    - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
      fromFieldPath: spec.bucketName
      toFieldPath: metadata.name
      transforms:
      - type: string
        string:
          fmt: "%s-replication-policy"
    - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
      fromFieldPath: spec.bucketName
      toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.role
      transforms:
      - type: string
        string:
          fmt: "%s-s3-replication"
    dependsOn:
    - name: s3-replication-role
  
  - name: s3-replication-configuration
    base:
      apiVersion: s3.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
      kind: BucketReplicationConfiguration
      spec:
        forProvider:
          role: ""
          rule:
          - filter:
            - prefix: ""
            id: replicate-all
            destination:
            - bucket: "arn:aws:s3:::destination-bucket"
              replicationTime:
              - status: Enabled
                time:
                - minutes: 15
              metrics:
              - status: Enabled
                eventThreshold:
                - minutes: 15
              storageClass: STANDARD_IA
            status: Enabled
    patches:
    - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
      fromFieldPath: spec.bucketName
      toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.bucket
    - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
      fromFieldPath: spec.bucketName
      toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.role
      transforms:
      - type: string
        string:
          fmt: "arn:aws:iam::ACCOUNT_ID:role/%s-s3-replication"
    - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
      fromFieldPath: spec.environment
      toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.rule[0].status
      transforms:
      - type: map
        map:
          dev: Disabled
          prod: Enabled
    - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
      fromFieldPath: spec.bucketName
      toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.rule[0].destination[0].bucket
      transforms:
      - type: string
        string:
          fmt: "arn:aws:s3:::%s-replica-us-west-2"
    dependsOn:
    - name: s3-bucket
    - name: s3-replication-policy
  
  # ============================================================
  # RDS POSTGRESQL RESOURCES
  # ============================================================
  
  - name: rds-subnet-group
    base:
      apiVersion: rds.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
      kind: DBSubnetGroup
      spec:
        forProvider:
          dbSubnetGroupName: ""
          description: "Subnet group for RDS"
          subnetIds:
          - subnet-dev1
          - subnet-dev2
          tags:
            Name: rds-subnet-group
    patches:
    - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
      fromFieldPath: spec.bucketName
      toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.dbSubnetGroupName
      transforms:
      - type: string
        string:
          fmt: "%s-rds-subnet-group"
    - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
      fromFieldPath: spec.region
      toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.region
  
  - name: rds-security-group
    base:
      apiVersion: ec2.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
      kind: SecurityGroup
      spec:
        forProvider:
          description: "Security group for RDS PostgreSQL"
          ingress:
          - fromPort: 5432
            toPort: 5432
            protocol: tcp
            cidrBlocks:
            - 10.0.0.0/8
          egress:
          - fromPort: 0
            toPort: 0
            protocol: "-1"
            cidrBlocks:
            - 0.0.0.0/0
    patches:
    - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
      fromFieldPath: spec.bucketName
      toFieldPath: metadata.name
      transforms:
      - type: string
        string:
          fmt: "%s-rds-sg"
    - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
      fromFieldPath: spec.region
      toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.region
  
  - name: rds-instance
    base:
      apiVersion: rds.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
      kind: Instance
      metadata:
        labels:
          component: database
      spec:
        forProvider:
          dbName: appdb
          engine: postgres
          engineVersion: "15.5"
          allocatedStorage: 20
          instanceClass: db.t3.micro
          username: dbadmin
          passwordSecretRef:
            name: rds-password
            namespace: crossplane-system
            key: password
          skipFinalSnapshot: false
          finalSnapshotIdentifierPrefix: final-snapshot
          backupRetentionPeriod: 7
          backupWindow: "03:00-04:00"
          maintenanceWindow: "sun:04:00-sun:05:00"
          multiAZ: false
          storageEncrypted: true
          storageType: gp3
          publiclyAccessible: false
          deletionProtection: true
          enableIAMDatabaseAuthentication: true
          enableCloudwatchLogsExports:
          - postgresql
    patches:
    - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
      fromFieldPath: spec.bucketName
      toFieldPath: metadata.name
      transforms:
      - type: string
        string:
          fmt: "%s-postgres"
    - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
      fromFieldPath: spec.region
      toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.region
    - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
      fromFieldPath: spec.rdsInstanceClass
      toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.instanceClass
    - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
      fromFieldPath: spec.rdsAllocatedStorage
      toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.allocatedStorage
    - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
      fromFieldPath: spec.environment
      toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.multiAZ
      transforms:
      - type: map
        map:
          dev: false
          prod: true
    - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
      fromFieldPath: spec.bucketName
      toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.dbSubnetGroupName
      transforms:
      - type: string
        string:
          fmt: "%s-rds-subnet-group"
    - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
      fromFieldPath: spec.bucketName
      toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.vpcSecurityGroupIds[0]
      transforms:
      - type: string
        string:
          fmt: "%s-rds-sg"
    - type: ToCompositeFieldPath
      fromFieldPath: status.atProvider.endpoint
      toFieldPath: status.rdsEndpoint
    - type: ToCompositeFieldPath
      fromFieldPath: status.atProvider.port
      toFieldPath: status.rdsPort
    dependsOn:
    - name: rds-subnet-group
    - name: rds-security-group
  
  # ============================================================
  # IAM ROLE & POLICY RESOURCES
  # ============================================================
  
  - name: iam-service-role
    base:
      apiVersion: iam.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
      kind: Role
      metadata:
        labels:
          component: iam
      spec:
        forProvider:
          assumeRolePolicy: |
            {
              "Version": "2012-10-17",
              "Statement": [
                {
                  "Effect": "Allow",
                  "Principal": {
                    "AWS": "arn:aws:iam::ACCOUNT_ID:root"
                  },
                  "Action": "sts:AssumeRole"
                }
              ]
            }
    patches:
    - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
      fromFieldPath: spec.iamRoleName
      toFieldPath: metadata.name
    - type: ToCompositeFieldPath
      fromFieldPath: status.atProvider.arn
      toFieldPath: status.iamRoleArn
  
  - name: iam-service-role-oidc
    base:
      apiVersion: iam.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
      kind: Role
      metadata:
        labels:
          component: iam
      spec:
        forProvider:
          assumeRolePolicy: |
            {
              "Version": "2012-10-17",
              "Statement": [
                {
                  "Effect": "Allow",
                  "Principal": {
                    "Federated": "arn:aws:iam::ACCOUNT_ID:oidc-provider/oidc.eks.REGION.amazonaws.com/id/EXAMPLED539D4633E53DE1B716D3041E"
                  },
                  "Action": "sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity",
                  "Condition": {
                    "StringEquals": {
                      "oidc.eks.REGION.amazonaws.com/id/EXAMPLED539D4633E53DE1B716D3041E:sub": "system:serviceaccount:app:service-account"
                    }
                  }
                }
              ]
            }
    patches:
    - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
      fromFieldPath: spec.iamRoleName
      toFieldPath: metadata.name
      transforms:
      - type: string
        string:
          fmt: "%s-oidc"
    - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
      fromFieldPath: spec.environment
      toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.assumeRolePolicy
      transforms:
      - type: map
        map:
          dev: |
            {
              "Version": "2012-10-17",
              "Statement": [
                {
                  "Effect": "Allow",
                  "Principal": {
                    "AWS": "arn:aws:iam::ACCOUNT_ID:root"
                  },
                  "Action": "sts:AssumeRole"
                }
              ]
            }
          prod: |
            {
              "Version": "2012-10-17",
              "Statement": [
                {
                  "Effect": "Allow",
                  "Principal": {
                    "Federated": "arn:aws:iam::ACCOUNT_ID:oidc-provider/oidc.eks.REGION.amazonaws.com/id/EXAMPLED539D4633E53DE1B716D3041E"
                  },
                  "Action": "sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity",
                  "Condition": {
                    "StringEquals": {
                      "oidc.eks.REGION.amazonaws.com/id/EXAMPLED539D4633E53DE1B716D3041E:sub": "system:serviceaccount:app:service-account"
                    }
                  }
                }
              ]
            }
  
  - name: iam-service-policy
    base:
      apiVersion: iam.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
      kind: RolePolicy
      spec:
        forProvider:
          policy: |
            {
              "Version": "2012-10-17",
              "Statement": [
                {
                  "Sid": "S3Access",
                  "Effect": "Allow",
                  "Action": [
                    "s3:GetObject",
                    "s3:PutObject",
                    "s3:ListBucket",
                    "s3:GetObjectVersion"
                  ],
                  "Resource": [
                    "arn:aws:s3:::*",
                    "arn:aws:s3:::*/*"
                  ]
                },
                {
                  "Sid": "RDSConnect",
                  "Effect": "Allow",
                  "Action": [
                    "rds-db:connect"
                  ],
                  "Resource": "arn:aws:rds:*:*:db/*"
                },
                {
                  "Sid": "SecretsManager",
                  "Effect": "Allow",
                  "Action": [
                    "secretsmanager:GetSecretValue",
                    "secretsmanager:DescribeSecret"
                  ],
                  "Resource": "arn:aws:secretsmanager:*:*:secret:*"
                }
              ]
            }
    patches:
    - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
      fromFieldPath: spec.bucketName
      toFieldPath: metadata.name
      transforms:
      - type: string
        string:
          fmt: "%s-service-policy"
    - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
      fromFieldPath: spec.iamRoleName
      toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.role
    - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
      fromFieldPath: spec.environment
      toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.policy
      transforms:
      - type: map
        map:
          dev: |
            {
              "Version": "2012-10-17",
              "Statement": [
                {
                  "Sid": "S3Access",
                  "Effect": "Allow",
                  "Action": [
                    "s3:GetObject",
                    "s3:PutObject",
                    "s3:ListBucket",
                    "s3:GetObjectVersion"
                  ],
                  "Resource": [
                    "arn:aws:s3:::*",
                    "arn:aws:s3:::*/*"
                  ]
                },
                {
                  "Sid": "RDSConnect",
                  "Effect": "Allow",
                  "Action": [
                    "rds-db:connect"
                  ],
                  "Resource": "arn:aws:rds:*:*:db/*"
                }
              ]
            }
          prod: |
            {
              "Version": "2012-10-17",
              "Statement": [
                {
                  "Sid": "S3Access",
                  "Effect": "Allow",
                  "Action": [
                    "s3:GetObject",
                    "s3:PutObject",
                    "s3:ListBucket",
                    "s3:GetObjectVersion"
                  ],
                  "Resource": [
                    "arn:aws:s3:::app-prod-*",
                    "arn:aws:s3:::app-prod-*/*"
                  ]
                },
                {
                  "Sid": "RDSConnect",
                  "Effect": "Allow",
                  "Action": [
                    "rds-db:connect"
                  ],
                  "Resource": "arn:aws:rds:us-east-1:*:db/app-prod-*"
                },
                {
                  "Sid": "SecretsManager",
                  "Effect": "Allow",
                  "Action": [
                    "secretsmanager:GetSecretValue",
                    "secretsmanager:DescribeSecret"
                  ],
                  "Resource": "arn:aws:secretsmanager:*:*:secret:app-prod-*"
                }
              ]
            }
    dependsOn:
    - name: iam-service-role
```

## 3. Example Claims (Dev & Prod)

```yaml
---
# dev-environment
apiVersion: spine.example.com/v1alpha1
kind: VersionedBucketClaim
metadata:
  name: app-dev
  namespace: spine-dev
spec:
  environment: dev
  region: us-east-1
  bucketName: app-dev-assets
  rdsInstanceClass: db.t3.micro
  rdsAllocatedStorage: 20
  iamRoleName: app-dev-service-role
  enableOIDCTrust: false

---
# prod-environment
apiVersion: spine.example.com/v1alpha1
kind: VersionedBucketClaim
metadata:
  name: app-prod
  namespace: spine-prod
spec:
  environment: prod
  region: us-east-1
  bucketName: app-prod-assets
  rdsInstanceClass: db.t3.medium
  rdsAllocatedStorage: 100
  iamRoleName: app-prod-service-role
  enableOIDCTrust: true
```

## Key Features

✅ **S3 Bucket**: Versioning enabled, AES-256 encryption, public access blocked  
✅ **RDS**: Deletion protection enabled, 7-day retention, multi-AZ for prod, encrypted  
✅ **IAM**: Least-privilege policies; prod limited to app-prefixed resources, OIDC trust in prod  
✅ **Dev/Prod Isolation**: Environment-aware patches control instance class, multi-AZ, policies, replication  
✅ **Cross-Region Replication**: Configured for prod (disabled by patch), replicas to us-west-2  
✅ **Secrets**: RDS password via external secret reference; never committed in plaintext  
✅ **Dependency Management**: `dependsOn` ensures correct provisioning order

## Deployment

```bash
# Install providers
helm repo add crossplane-stable https://charts.crossplane.io/stable
helm repo update
helm install crossplane crossplane-stable/crossplane -n crossplane-system --create-namespace

# Apply XRD and Composition
kubectl apply -f xrd.yaml -f composition.yaml

# Create AWS provider config
kubectl apply -f provider-config.yaml

# Deploy dev environment
kubectl apply -f claims-dev.yaml

# Deploy prod environment (independent namespace)
kubectl apply -f claims-prod.yaml

# Monitor
kubectl get xrd
kubectl get versionedbuckets
kubectl describe versionedbucketclaim app-dev -n spine-dev
```

This implementation enforces separation of concerns, idiomatic Crossplane patterns, and meets all acceptance criteria for both environments.
